response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg), transaction_averages AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM matched GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist), mix_averages AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS mix_avg_short_interest FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist), results AS (SELECT ta.transreg AS transaction_reference, ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, ta.avg_short_interest, ta.avg_option_volume_ratio, ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(ma.mix_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS ta JOIN mix_averages AS ma ON ta.ordertypedist IS ma.ordertypedist) SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
